description: Evaluate all frozen PSM/RXPSM final students with the same frozen DURA; reuse the already completed F20/F21 raw+DURA controls. No training, tuning or model selection.
authorization: 用户在本侧聊明确要求：补充接入 DURA 网络的星地性能。仅补冻结模型评估，不接管或修改主任务。

data.label_map_ref: Existing F0 six-TX class order, unchanged

data.validation_ref: Reuse existing Phase1 VALIDATED_ONCE handles. p2_min_v1/capsule_id/split_id not applicable to Phase1.
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 frozen zero-adaptation evaluation; no support/query fitting

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 fixed F0 test, raw versus frozen common DURA-LU; all models/default heads frozen. DURA has source L/U IQ access, no TX truth/F/target training. F20 means supervised F, not an entirely L-only combined system. No Phase2 or orbital claims.

checkpoint.initialization: No training: reuse fixed final E50/11100 students
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing complete source-only segment chains; frozen_inference.load_F/load_G verify actual ancestry and matching F0 roles. DURA source contract, role_ids, counts, RX and days compared in preflight.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: F/G source contract fields match; actual payload/ancestry checked before target prediction. No model training or target-feedback selection.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All six previously frozen final students, no choice among target results

execution.gpu_policy: Seeds 2026092701/02/03 on GPUs5/6/7 respectively; <=1 own worker/card, <=2 total compute workers/card including other owners, free>=12000MiB; one own independent CPU scorer.
execution.stop_rule: Real frozen F+G L_s-only smoke first; PASS immediately continues. Smoke failure or two identical technical failures stop new dispatch; never stop or modify other owners. No performance-based retries, tuning, reranking, or candidate selection.

expected_artifacts: smoke.json: real frozen F+G, L_s IQ only, zero target reads
Per-row raw reused plus new DURA seven-view predictions, complete.json before separate truth scorer
Per-row scores/complete.json and scores.json, per-view/TX/RX/day/RX-day metrics and paired net corrections
Mean/sample SD and paired comparisons against common-G F20/F21 for all three seeds
PID/CWD/cmdline/GPU/log progress evidence; all partial outputs retained

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.cric_dura_comparison.evaluation: each row all seven raw/G predictions fixed before independent CPU truth-last; no score collection until ALL_SCORED
metrics_plan.goal_population: Same fixed target test, 168000 records/view, all seven unseen target RX. Raw and DURA shown separately; shared-G paired F comparisons, no source V acceptance.
